title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I have news for you about a trade but you can’t break it on Twitter. I need to have this one for boosting our engagement numbers.
GTFo
What’s going on
Hardy is going to the A’s.
I feel like this is a joke
No way
Yeah. But please, let me have this one. We’ve been reviewing the numbers and I need the RTs and responses that come with this.
Frankie Montas and Sheldon Neuse (Oakland’s No. 10) coming back.
I gotta get it
I just applied for job at Salomon
WaPo
Duck the metrics
Lol I need it because I need to prove I can keep my job.
What do you mean
I’ve been handling day to day stuff and would like to show I deserve a bigger role. Right now, though, none of the numbers are looking good so its tough for me to show I’m any good
Ugh
Well I’m trying to track it down ...
But like...
I don’t wanna screw you
I would prefer not to be screwed.
Emphasized “I would prefer not to be screwed.”
You hearing anything?
No, was actually refreshing twitter to see if anything was said because I’m not sure why we wouldn’t have announced it
Oh shit, apparently its not longer a discussion. Good thing you didn’t go with it
I’m at the bar and wouldn’t be able to hear you
Ok
I left the moment I got an email
I’m in Vegas sitting in my hotel room
Lol
Now I’m out
Smart man
